headline: China Factory Output Grows at Fastest Pace in Six Months Despite Export Slowdown
summary: China's factory output grew at its fastest pace in six months according to the RatingDog PMI, even as overall factory growth slowed in October due to easing export orders.
why: Purchasing Managers' Index data provides a crucial gauge of manufacturing sector health and broader macroeconomic momentum in the world's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Mixed PMI indicators show divergent signals for industrial output and export demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Conflicting manufacturing metrics create uncertainty regarding the strength of economic recovery and industrial demand.
